data.title: ONE PIECE
data.description:
As a child, Monkey D. Luffy was inspired to become a pirate by listening to the tales of the buccaneer “Red-Haired” Shanks. But his life changed when Luffy accidentally ate the Gum-Gum Devil Fruit and gained the power to stretch like rubber…at the cost of never being able to swim again! Years later, still vowing to become the king of the pirates, Luffy sets out on his adventure…one guy alone in a rowboat, in search of the legendary “One Piece,” said to be the greatest treasure in the world…

*Source: VIZ Media, Vol. 1*

tags_v2.name: Tsundere
tags_v2.description: Characters who are initially cold, hostile, or prickly toward others (especially love interests), but gradually or occasionally reveal a softer, warmer, or caring side beneath their abrasive exterior. The term is a combination of "tsun" (ツンツン, tsuntsun, aloof or prickly) and "dere" (デレデレ, deredere, lovey-dovey).

tags_v2.description:
Catch-all for transgender characters. For transgender themes in stories, use regular Transgender tag.

Regularly appears in japanese media as "Newhalf" (from, Fakku):
> Vogue term used primarily in the entertainment industries often used interchangeably to describe gender nonconforming men who present as female, and some trans women who choose to identify as such. Essentially “half man, half woman”.
